base: gpu-search-features-v1 normalization, tokens, UTF8 FNV1a32 bucket1023, word and char feature IDs unchanged

wordFamily.multipleTokens: .75 * mean(word table unigrams) + .25 * mean(word table bigrams)

bigrams.order: adjacent ordered pairs of first32 tokens, each first64 Unicode scalar values
bigrams.encoding: ASCII b: then uint32LE UTF8 byte length token A then UTF8 A then uint32LE UTF8 byte length token B then UTF8 B
bigrams.duplicates: preserve repeated occurrences and hash collisions; never deduplicate

normalization: L2 normalize pooled f32 vector; invalid if norm<1e-8
